archetypes.name: dyn-state-publish
archetypes.rationale: Tree replacement and interrupted backup recovery are the main data-loss risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed run-log tree replacement flow. Focus on symlink and non-directory refusal, backup restoration after interrupted publishes, backup cleanup, and whether a failed staged rename preserves the previous committed tree. Check both run-tree and breadcrumbs callers for equivalent behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-warning-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The change narrows formerly swallowed state IO failures without changing caller exit semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review warning and exception contracts around _commit_run and larch_log_flush_main. Confirm expected exceptions are logged to stderr, nonzero breadcrumb publish results are visible, flush still returns 0 where intended, and public CLI boundaries do not leak ValueError. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
